summary: Tenaris S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited 2026 second-quarter results and related announcements. The report covers financial performance, an interim dividend of $0.59 per share, market outlook, and board changes. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The board resignations are routine personal/commitment reasons, not abrupt or forced changes. The filing is a standard periodic earnings report, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
